note: Verified for the Round H live UAT. Figures read verbatim from the Model pricing table row 'Claude Opus 5': base input $5/MTok, 5m cache writes $6.25/MTok, 1h cache writes $10/MTok, cache hits and refreshes $0.50/MTok, output $25/MTok. Standard first-party API pricing only: this runtime sends no 'speed' parameter (so Fast mode's $10/$50 does not apply), no 'inference_geo' (so the US-only 1.1x multiplier does not apply), and does not use the Batch API.

claude-opus-5.source: Anthropic published schedule, platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, 'Model pricing' table, row 'Claude Opus 5'.
claude-opus-5.cache_write_basis: 5-minute. PROVEN, not assumed: backend/cockpit_v4 contains no occurrence of cache_control; the assembled V4 request carries only {type,text} system blocks; backend/llm/anthropic_provider.py calls caching.usage() (which READS response usage) and never caching.compose() (the only function that sets cache_control). So this runtime requests no prompt caching and cache_creation_input_tokens is always 0, making cache_write_tokens always 0 in the ledger. The 5-minute price is recorded as the applicable basis should caching ever be enabled, because the codebase's own EPHEMERAL constant is {"type": "ephemeral"} with no ttl, which is the 5-minute default. See ROUND_H_LIVE_UAT.md for the full proof.
